title: Find the home team that lost the fewest matches in the 2015/2016 season wit
question: Find the home team that lost the fewest matches in the 2015/2016 season within the league that has the highest total number of goals (home + away) across all seasons. Return the team's long name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t.XCL_173
FROM Team t
JOIN Match m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013
WHERE m.XCL_008 = (
    SELECT l.XCL_003
    FROM League l
    JOIN Match m2 ON l.XCL_003 = m2.XCL_008
    GROUP BY l.XCL_003
    ORDER BY SUM(m2.XCL_015 + m2.XCL_016) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
AND m.XCL_016 > m.XCL_015
GROUP BY t.XCL_171
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1
